praises: 2TB of storage at $1,799 sale — the biggest SSD per dollar anywhere in the gram range
Ryzen AI 7 445 runs cool and quiet while beating Intel U-series in multi-core office work
Copilot+ NPU (50 TOPS) at a value-line price
16-inch 16:10 touch screen with numeric keypad in a light chassis (~1.7 kg est.)
Only AMD option in the whole Canadian gram retail lineup
complaints: Dim ~250-nit FHD+ panel is the same weak value-line display as the gram Book 15.6
Radeon 720M is a weak iGPU — lighter gaming only at low settings
Value-line plasticky build, a clear step below magnesium gram Pro chassis
60 Hz and Wi-Fi 6E only at a $2,249 list price
16GB soldered LPDDR5X with no upgrade path

design_philosophy: The AMD gram Book 16 extends the value sub-line with a Ryzen AI 400-series platform, bringing Copilot+ NPU capability and a huge 2TB SSD to the cheapest 16-inch gram. It keeps the value-line compromises — dim FHD+ panel, plasticky chassis, soldered RAM — but the price-per-storage and efficient Zen5 silicon make it the sleeper of the Book line at its sale price.
